title: Three Tokens Force Exponential Feature Rank in Nonnegative Kernel Attention
abstract: arXiv:2608.11427v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Full attention exposes every token pair, whereas kernel attention compresses a sequence into a fixed-dimensional sketch. We show that this distinction becomes exponential at the first context length containing two competing candidates. On Min-IP over Boolean inputs, rank-one normalized kernel attention solves every sequence of length at most two exactly. In contrast, any single normalized nonnegative kernel-attention head that succeeds on all three-token sequences with error strictly below $1/2$ requires $2^{\Omega(m)}$ features, even with arbitrary finite-dimensional tokenwise values and an arbitrary query-dependent affine readout. Dense softmax solves the same task with $m$-dimensional scores and constant temperature. The conclusion survives position-dependent token maps and a causal final query. As context length grows, the lower bound approaches the exact $2^m$-feature realization. Separately, for deterministic multihead, multilayer

translated_title: 三个令牌迫使非负核注意力中的特征秩呈指数增长
translated_abstract: 摘要：全注意力机制暴露了每一对令牌，而核注意力则将序列压缩为固定维度的草图。我们表明，在包含两个竞争候选者的首个上下文长度处，这种区别变得呈指数级。在布尔输入的Min-IP问题上，秩一的归一化核注意力能够精确解决长度至多二的所有序列。相比之下，任何单个归一化非负核注意力头，若要在所有三令牌序列上以严格低于$1/2$的错误率成功，则需要$2^{\Omega(m)}$个特征，即使具有任意有限维度的逐令牌值和任意的查询依赖仿射读出。密集softmax以$m$维分数和恒定温度解决了相同任务。该结论在位置依赖的令牌映射和因果最终查询下依然成立。随着上下文长度增长，下界接近精确的$2^m$特征实现。此外，对于确定性多头、多层架构，也进行了单独讨论。
tldr: 本文证明在Min-IP布尔输入上，仅三个令牌的序列就能迫使任何归一化非负核注意力头需要指数级（$2^{\Omega(m)}$）的特征维度才能达到低于1/2的错误率，而密集softmax仅需线性维度，揭示了核注意力在上下文长度增长时的根本局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that on Min-IP Boolean inputs, sequences of just three tokens force any normalized nonnegative kernel attention head to require exponential ($2^{\Omega(m)}$) feature dimensions for error below 1/2, while dense softmax needs only linear dimensions, revealing a fundamental limitation of kernel attention as context length grows.
